code='''def transform(grid):
    n=len(grid); m=len(grid[0])
    anchors=[(i,next(iter(set(row)-{0}))) for i,row in enumerate(grid) if set(row)-{0}]
    # Continue the periodic row pattern indicated by the colored stripes.
    p=max(1,len(anchors))
    while True:
        vals={}
        ok=True
        for i,c in anchors:
            r=i%p
            if r in vals and vals[r]!=c: ok=False; break
            vals[r]=c
        if ok: break
        p+=1
    # fill undetermined phases by cycling through observed stripe colors
    colors=[]
    for _,c in anchors:
        if c not in colors: colors.append(c)
    for r in range(p):
        if r not in vals: vals[r]=colors[len(vals)%len(colors)]
    return [[(next(iter(set(row)-{0})) if set(row)-{0} else vals[i%p])]*m for i,row in enumerate(grid)]
'''
